verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail sells lease-grade addresses (TruLease, with a one-year lease agreement and an optional utility bill) and residency-grade addresses (TruResidence) alongside its mailbox, and includes a free registered agent with mailbox plans, so a founder can pair these from one provider. LLC formation, however, is only self-paced TruStart video guidance, not a done-for-you filing service, and TruLease is never tied explicitly to foreign qualification. missing for 10: a done-for-you LLC formation/filing service, explicit support for foreign qualification filings with TruLease, independent or hands-on corroboration of the bundled offering.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pair the address with entity services — LLC formation, lease-grade addresses for foreign qualification, or residency-grade addresses — from the same provider

citations.quote: Establish a business location by renting a commercial office space backed by a lease agreement, physical address, and utility service to meet compliance requirements for financial accounts, Amazon Store, and more.
When renting an office, you'll sign a one-year lease agreement that verifies your business has legal rights to the office space.
TruResidence (TruRes) provides you with a verified U.S. residential address, helping you maintain U.S. ties for personal accounts and receive mail online.
Choose a plan that grows with you—whether you need a secure online mailbox, a home address for personal accounts, or a physical office address with lease agreements and utility bills
Self-paced videos to show you how to form an LLC, open a business bank account, and stay compliant with state taxes and laws.
As your registered agent, VPM will receive service of process, legal notices, and other important state correspondences on your behalf. ... Included FREE with all virtual mailbox plans.
